So 2026-09-01 would be... 2026 is not leap year. 2026-01-01 is Thursday. 2026-09-01 is 243 days later. 243 mod 7 = 243 - 238 = 5. So 2026-09-01 is Thursday + 5 days = Tuesday? Wait, Thursday + 5 days = Tuesday? Let's do: Thursday + 1 = Friday, +2 = Saturday, +3 = Sunday, +4 = Monday, +5 = Tuesday. So 2026-09-01 is Tuesday. Then 2026-09-02 is Wednesday, 2026-09-03 is Thursday. So next Friday after 2026-09-03 is 2026-09-09. So date: 2026-09-09.
